与城市生活一起成长(Growing up with city life): 一篇关于城市生活的B1记叙文:汤姆的经历、感受与成长。
Little by little, things began to change. Tom thanked Ben for the honest advice. People around Tom often share different ideas about the city square. They live in a high-rise near the station.
Tom plans to study music harder this term. On Thursday evenings, Tom reviews the notes from class. The experience taught Tom more than any book could. Best of all, steam rose from the bonnet.
Tom's dream job is to be a engineer. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Tom wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Labels now show food miles per pack.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. Tom believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Ben always says that small steps matter more than big plans. For example, their investment made the factory bigger.
The city square looked quieter than usual that evening. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Tom has practiced badminton for three years and won a prize last term.
